name: Find the Kittens (43)
desc:
🐱 Find the Kittens is a scavenger hunt game where you must find the kittens hidden across multiple islands. While some kittens are easy to find, others require more skill and patience to locate. Can you find them all?

👍 Please consider liking and favoriting the game if you enjoy it.

👥 Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/communities/646725839/Find-the-Kittens

This game is inspired by many other "Find the" games, especially Find the Stickmen by robey100.

scripts.title: Get all cats
scripts.features: teleports you to all cats with a 0.05 delay
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local char = player.Character
local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart

for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if v.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and v:IsA("Decal") then
		if v.Parent:FindFirstChild("badgeGiver") then
			hrp.CFrame = v.Parent:GetPivot()
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Find the Kittens Auto Collect
scripts.features: jsut auto gets all cats except 1, to get the last one u gotta join the roblox group they have
scripts.script:
local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

task.spawn(function()
	local spherecheck = game:GetService("Players"):FindFirstChild("Sphered1132")
	if spherecheck then
		local hint = Instance.new("Hint")
		hint.Text = "Nice, you're in the same game as the creator of this script"
		hint.Parent = workspace
		task.delay(3, function()
			hint:Destroy()
		end)
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	local finding = workspace:GetDescendants()
	for _, obj in ipairs(finding) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == "Part" then
			for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
				if child.Name == "TouchInterest" then
					local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if hrp then
						hrp.CFrame = obj.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
						task.wait(0.55) -- change this if you want, it affects teleport speed, 0.55 works fine for me
					end
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
